text: {"name": "rf_update_tx_state", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Resets TX counter fields and updates the RF transmit state, sequence counter, and calibration flags from channel, gain, and calibration tables.", "subsystem": "rf", "var_renames": {"a1": "rf_state", "v1": "tx_flags", "v4": "gain_table_idx", "v5": "tx_table_idx", "v6": "tx_channel_entry", "v7": "tx_state_flags", "v8": "tx_seq", "v9": "gain_table_entry", "v10": "freq_raw", "v11": "tx_state_cal", "v12": "freq_flag", "v13": "cal_value"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 4, "meaning": "source frequency/channel field copied to offset 48"}, {"offset": 24, "meaning": "raw frequency/channel word used for threshold checks"}, {"offset": 27, "meaning": "TX table index (0xFF means no per-entry update)"}, {"offset": 28, "meaning": "gain/band table index"}, {"offset": 29, "meaning": "channel index used in channel table arithmetic"}, {"offset": 30, "meaning": "TX/RF flag word controlling TX path state"}, {"offset": 32, "meaning": "TX sequence number captured from table entry"}, {"offset": 36, "meaning": "zeroed TX counter/state word"}, {"offset": 40, "meaning": "zeroed TX counter/state word"}, {"offset": 48, "meaning": "frequency/channel copy used by RF transmit path"}, {"offset": 50, "meaning": "computed TX state/config byte"}, {"offset": 51, "meaning": "TX state byte adjusted by calibration value"}, {"offset": 52, "meaning": "frequency-threshold flag"}, {"offset": 53, "meaning": "byte calibration value returned by rf_get_cal_entry"}, {"offset": 66, "meaning": "mirror of TX state/calibration byte"}]}
